intro: Designed for adaptable work and study, our Workout Table brings together sleek style, smart height control, and thoughtful touches to support your focus and comfort.

features.title: Compact and contemporary
features.text: With a 1200x650 mm top and premium pine finish, the table fits perfectly into small rooms or shared spaces without compromising on workspace or style.

features.title: Smart height memory
features.text: Adjust your desk height with a touch or store up to four presets for quick transitions—ideal for alternating between tasks without resetting every time.

features.title: Curves for comfort and safety
features.text: Curved front edges offer ergonomic arm placement and added safety—perfect for active learners, work-from-home setups, or creative projects.

features.title: Level on any floor
features.text: Levellers under legs ensure your desk stays balanced, even on uneven surfaces—making it ideal for any room in your home or office.

features.title: Strong from the base up
features.text: A solid steel frame and powder-coated legs support up to 80 kg, ensuring durability and stability even with daily, heavy-duty use.

features.title: Whisper-quiet power operation
features.text: Powered by an efficient motor, our table offers smooth and silent height adjustment while lifting. It’s built with solid steel linkages, for strength and designed to move silently, every time.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Workout Power Operated Height Adjustable Study Table With 4 Memory Presets
